control_failures.control_label: arc flash boundary and protective equipment
integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: high potential incident - thermal exposure at TX-9001

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 2 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ARC_FLASH_PPE_AND_BOUNDARY: the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on TX-9001 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically testing for dead and applying earths. TX-9001 (mine switchgear) is in service for pit and workshop distribution. The task proceeded during shift handover while the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 17 May 2022 a high potential incident was recorded on TX-9001 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during shift handover; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
